title: Session
description: One authentication episode, as the session store holds it. The state values are the states in states.json.

state.description: Lifecycle position. The same four names appear in the protocol's states.json.

account-id.description: The principal this session speaks for. Absent while anonymous, required once authenticated.

tenant-id.description: Tenant the session is acting inside. A tenant-scoped grant is evaluated against this, never against the account's own tenant.

impersonated-by.description: Support principal driving this session on the account holder's behalf. Absent on ordinary sessions; account-id still names the customer, never the agent.

authentication-strength.description: How much was proved. Ordered none < recovery < single-factor < multi-factor by acl; the order is not expressible here. A permission with requires-multi-factor is denied below "multi-factor", and "recovery" additionally denies everything but credential repair.

issued-at.description: When the session began. Equal to created-at for an anonymous session, later for one that was elevated.

expires-at.description: Absolute deadline. Never extended in place; a refresh issues a new session.

idle-expires-at.description: Sliding deadline, moved forward on use. The session ends at the earlier of this and expires-at, so it can only shorten the lifetime. Absent where no idle policy applies, as on service-account sessions.

revoked-at.description: When revocation took effect at the store. Present exactly when state is "revoked".

revocation-reason.description: Why, in the revoker's own words. Shown to the principal on their next attempt.

client-fingerprint.description: Opaque digest of the client the session was issued to. Compared, never decoded.
